claim.statement: There are no CRDs, operators, plugin system, custom scheduler scorers, Helm or sidecars by design; extension happens through the seven built-in resource types, scripts calling the CLI or API, and the integration points listed in the other extensibility claims.

sources.quote: Without CRDs, there is no operator framework, by design.
Meat uses a fixed set of scoring dimensions with configurable weights
**No plugins:** The built-in command set is comprehensive enough.
When the configuration is already 15 lines of TOML, a package manager

claim.measurable: Applying an unknown kind (a CRD) is rejected or reported as dropped; there is no relish plugin discovery (relish-<name> on PATH is not dispatched); scheduler weights are the only scheduling knob (placement labels, replicas = "*"); no admission webhook or controller registration API exists.
interfaces: relish apply (unknown kind -> Dropped in report)
claim.gap: rg -n -i "plugin|extension|controller|CRD" docs/manual returned only docs/manual/09_kubernetes.md (CRDs listed as dropped on import).
